666 and this is what we find in our earliest manuscript witness to this passage that's Papyrus 47 or p47 which
dates to probably the second half of the 3r century CE now at the end of the 3dr century CE we have another manuscript
p115 that actually has the number as 616 but it's okay because both numbers are a reference to
the same individual because this number is referred to at the end of that passage as the number of his name which clearly means we're dealing with a
numerical encoding of the name of a person using gatria gatria is this
convention of using the sums of the numerical values of the letters of a word or a name to encode that word or
name and 6166 and 6 66 are two different ways to encode the name Nero Caesar one
is transliterating it into Hebrew from Greek and the other is transliterating it into Hebrew from Latin here is a coin from the reign of
Nero ceser you'll note that this is a means of buying and selling and the impression on the coin has Nero's image
as well as Nero's name and that impression could be referred to in Greek as a mark as well but you'll see on the
left Nero Kaiser this is the Latin spelling of the name and if you transliterate that into Hebrew characters you get Nero Kaiser and that
using gatria adds up to 616 here is another coin from Nero's Reign the inscription here however is
not in Latin it is in Greek and to transliterate the name Nero Kaiser into Greek gives us neon Kaiser with a new on
the end now you transliterate that into he Hebrew and then you get naron Kaiser with a noon on the end of the first name and in Hebrew the noon has a numerical
value of 50 so if we transliterate this into Hebrew and then add up the numerical values of the characters we
get 666 the only two numbers that have any real argument to make for being original to Revelation
13:18 are 666 and 616 666 most Scholars agree as probably original 616 probably
popped up in an area where Latin was a lot more common so this is a reference to Nero Caesar Nero Caesar was the
